assessment_summary: Case Study Discussion: The purpose of this assignment is for students to apply data visualisation concepts to real-world business cases and datasets. Case studies will be assigned on a weekly basis and discussed in class.

In-class Assessment: The purpose of this assignment is for students to evaluate and discuss data visualsation solutions as they are being applied to real-world business cases and datasets. Case studies will be assigned on a weekly basis and discussed in class.
Individual Assignment: The purpose of this assignment is for students to use data visualisation techniques to address a business problem within a particular business case context.

Group Project Report: The purpose of this assignment is to enable students to explain principles and best practices of data visualisation as it applies to a business or societal context, conduct research, stimulate broader thinking through collaborative teamwork and present their findings in written format.

Group Project Presentation: The purpose of this assignment is for students to evaluate and recommend data visualisation solutions in a manner relevant to decision makers. The assignment will assess students on their ability to utilize essential business communication skills and correspond with an audience in oral and interactive forms.

Skills-based Assessment: The purpose of this assignment is for students to develop the skills to design and develop data visualisation solutions. This are self-paced skill development exercises that have to be completed throughout the semester.
Detailed information for each assessment can be found on Canvas.

items.label: Overview paragraph 1
items.text: Data visualisation, storytelling, and scenario development are prominent analytical practices that are increasingly used by professionals seeking to use data for decision making. This unit aims to equip students with necessary knowledge and data visualisation skills, acquired through real-world projects and applications inspired by leading industry practices. Students develop a holistic view of data visualisation and acquire knowledge of related tools to deal with organisational and societal challenges. This unit focuses on business/organisational decision makers and their use of data visualisation. As such this unit does not require any prior IT, computer science or data science experience.

items.label: Learning outcome 1
items.text: LO1. Apply fundamental concepts of data visualisation to analyse and present data-related challenges in organisational and societal settings.

items.label: Learning outcome 2
items.text: LO2. Identify and analyse multi-disciplinary issues and ethical challenges associated with the use of data visualisation techniques.

items.label: Learning outcome 3
items.text: LO3. Explain principles and best practices of data visualisation as it applies to current and emerging industry trends.

items.label: Learning outcome 4
items.text: LO4. Design and develop data visualisations based on real world datasets.

items.label: Learning outcome 5
items.text: LO5. Recommend and evaluate data visualisation solutions and present outcomes orally and verbally.
